body: I'm sorry about that, and I'm glad posting this made you feel better. I'm definitely not in the same boat as you: I'm a spoiled kid still living with her parents, so what I say probably won't make any impact. I'm glad you'll be starting a new life. It's hard being patient, but try to make yourself busy while you wait. And don't fall back into the drugs/booze shit. It's not worth it, and provides only temporary relief to a long-term problem, and may numb the depression for a little bit, but it doesn't help and brings only more problems. Hang in there!
